text: むし　ポケモン　とか　ほのお　ポケモン　は　きらい　なの　ここに　もち　こまないでよ！

structure.jp: むし　ポケモン　とか　ほのお　ポケモン　は
structure.en: Bug Pokémon and Fire Pokémon and such

structure.jp: ここに　もち　こまないでよ！

patterns.name: 〜ないでください
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in ないで asks someone not to do something; the ください is dropped in casual speech. もち　こまないで = 'don't bring them in'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なの at the end makes the line sound like an explanation of how things are, in a feminine way. きらい　なの = 'I hate them, you see'.
